_note: Oven and air fryer conversions for tools/build-oven-pages.js. Gas marks: the Which? conversion table (gas marks 1-9 only: charts disagree below gas mark 1, so none is given). Fan: 'typically around 20°C less than conventional ovens' (Which?). Air fryer: 20°C below the recipe's oven temperature (conventional or fan) and 20-25% less time for fresh food; frozen food at the same temperature for about half the time (Instant Pot UK, Liana's Kitchen).
